mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is above 6% and rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and accelerating, it signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDPC1 growth is positive and accelerating but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
